section.title: Performing a scan in coupled mode
section.hierarchy_path: /Enhanced examination/CARE Contrast CT/Performing a scan in coupled mode

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 7.2.3 Performing a scan in coupled mode

If your CT scanner is connected to a bolus injector, communication allows you to start injection and scanning, and stop injection either via the CT scanner or via the bolus injector. If the bolus injector is released for the injection parameter transfer from the CT scanner to the bolus injector, the injection parameter are also editable on the Contrast parameter card.
1 Perform the scan in the usual way. ( Page 306 Scan)
If the connected bolus injector is not ready for injection yet, a yellow message bubble will be displayed that prompts you to check the bolus injector.
2 Check the bolus injector as described in the operator manual of the bolus injector.
3 Enable the bolus injector for injection.
If you have checked it already before loading, the yellow message bubbles Press foot switch or Press START together with a syringe icon indicate that both systems are ready for scanning.
As soon as the bolus injector is enabled for injection, the parameters are dimmed on the Contrast parameter card.
For more information on the remote CT scanner start, refer to the operator manual of the configured bolus injector.
4 Press the START key on the control box or the foot switch of the CT scanner to start both systems.
– or –
Press the START key on the bolus injector to start both systems.
After the injection, the effectively used injection parameters are updated on the Contrast parameter card, and are documented by the CT system.
Depending on the bolus injector, the bolus injector console shows nominal values of the injection protocol after the injection. On the Contrast parameter card, the achieved values are displayed.
For further instructions on switching the display to the achieved values of the injection (flow and pressure curve), refer to the operator manuals of the bolus injector manufacturer.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 356
7 Enhanced examination

The values for the injection phase duration and pressure limit which are displayed at the bolus injector and the Contrast parameter card can slightly differ. This behavior is caused by different rounding methods.
The contrast management and the injection parameters are documented via the following features:
MPPS
Patient protocol
E-Logbook

section.title: Canceling a scan in coupled mode
section.hierarchy_path: /Enhanced examination/CARE Contrast CT/Canceling a scan in coupled mode

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 7.2.4 Canceling a scan in coupled mode
For more information on the bolus injector handling, see the operator manual of the bolus injector manufacturer.
Observe the safety instructions in the operator manual of the bolus injector manufacturer.
CAUTION
Required injection protocol on the injector and the CT scanner do not match for the planned scan!
X-ray not, or only partially, usable.
◆ Before performing the coupled scan, verify that the:
Correct injection protocol has been transferred to the CT scanner and that it matches the injection protocol on the injector.
Patient data, contrast media parameters, and scan parameters are correct on the injector and the CT scanner.
Correct injection protocol has been selected when bringing the injector in the Ready status to start.
CAUTION
Injection stopped at the injector by the user without suspending the scan!
X-ray not, or only partially, usable.
◆ Press Suspend at scanner if not enough contrast media was administered.
◆ Stopping the injection at the injector does not stop automatically the scan.
◆ Click the Suspend button to cancel both, injection of contrast medium and radiation.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
7 Enhanced examination
If the injection is canceled at the bolus injector, the scan is not automatically stopped. ( Page 351 Start/Stop behavior in coupled/uncoupled mode)
– or –
Press the STOP key on the control box or the gantry panel to stop both systems.
Radiation and the injection of contrast medium is stopped immediately, and the entire system is blocked.

section.title: Using MinDose
section.hierarchy_path: /Enhanced examination/Cardiac CT/Acquiring an ECG-Gated Spiral/Using MinDose

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Using MinDose

The scanning with the MinDose option provides you the ability to activate an enforced dose modulation mechanism. In this way, you can reduce the dose beyond the high dose plateau down to a minimum of 4%. If MinDose is not available, the value of the dose plateau is reduced to 25%.

A typical application of MinDose are heart examinations where the functional analysis is not desired. Reconstructions outside the high dose plateau are possible but images do not have sufficient image quality for reporting or functional imaging.
Images obtained beyond the high dose plateau are of reduced image quality. Postprocessing applications may not accept these images.
You can modify the start and the end point of the high dose plateau also for the MinDose option.
1 On the Trigger parameter card, use the Pulsing selection list to switch between standard dose and MinDose .
2 Select MinDose - manual to activate the manual dose modulation for reducing the dose beyond the high dose plateau.
– or –
Select MinDose - auto to activate the automatic dose modulation for reducing the dose beyond the high dose plateau.
3 Load the mode.
A message box is displayed to inform you that the image quality for diagnostic purposes is not guaranteed.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30

section.title: Performing FlashCheck
section.hierarchy_path: /Enhanced examination/Cardiac CT/Turbo Flash Spiral Cardiac/Chest Pain/Performing FlashCheck

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Performing FlashCheck
WARNING
Short period of time to press the STOP key due to high table speed!
Contusions of the patient's body. Extractions of infusion lines or needles.
◆ Perform a test run of the table movement to ensure a risk free movement during Turbo Flash Spiral.
1 Load a Turbo Flash Spiral Cardiac or a Turbo Flash Spiral Chest Pain scan protocol into the chronicle.
If no patient weight is available, a dialog box is displayed prompting you to insert the patient weight.
WARNING
Weight limitation for Turbo Flash mode. Blocking scan due to exceeding the maximum load!
No scan in Turbo Flash mode possible.
◆ Check the maximum weight of the patient and the accessories, before positioning the patient.
If the patient weight exceeds 220 kg, use another scan acquisition mode instead.
2 Select a Turbo Flash Spiral Cardiac or Turbo Flash Spiral Chest Pain scan range.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
7 Enhanced examination
3 Click the FlashCheck button.
If a topogram is available, the Turbo Flash Training dialog box is displayed, prompting you to perform a test run of the patient table.
You are also prompted to insert the patient weight, if required.
4 On the Turbo Flash Training dialog box, click Start .
5 To move the patient table to its starting position, you are prompted to press the Move key. Follow the instructions on the screen.
The test run of the patient table and FlashCheck are started simultaneously.
The test run of the patient table is performed for all scan ranges of a Turbo Flash scan protocol.
The scan entry and the Load button are enabled. The results of the FlashCheck steps are saved for the selected range and all unscanned modes with comparable parameters.
CAUTION
Insufficient results of scanning and image reconstruction within parts of the heart anatomy in Cardiac ECG-gated examinations and ECG-triggered examinations!
Wrong diagnosis
◆ Make sure that the heart rate and the heart rhythm of the patient is within the recommended range for ECG-gated examinations and ECG-triggered examinations of the CT system.
◆ Consider possible changes of the heart rate and the heart rhythm due to patient breathing instructions, bolus injection, medication or patient's stress.
If no suitable heart rate can be achieved, we recommend performing an Adaptive Cardiac Sequence scan for Cardiac CT examinations or a standard ChestPain scan for chest pain examinations.
FlashCheck is possible with or without an instruction text. If no instruction text is selected, the evaluation is performed immediately.
You can repeat the FlashCheck as often as required.

If an autorange contains a Turbo Flash Spiral Cardiac or Turbo Flash Spiral Chest Pain scan, you need to perform FlashCheck before you can start the autorange for every Turbo Flash scan with different scan parameters.

section.title: Turbo Flash Spiral Chest Pain scan range
section.hierarchy_path: /Enhanced examination/Cardiac CT/Turbo Flash Spiral Cardiac/Chest Pain/Turbo Flash Spiral Chest Pain scan range

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Turbo Flash Spiral Chest Pain scan range

For the chest pain scan protocols, the chest pain FoV and a Chest Pain icon will be displayed in the topogram to show the cardiac or the standard dose range for the scan of the tomogram. Additionally, the recommended FoV is displayed.
The cardiac/standard dose range is always displayed, irrespective of the selected recon range. If you select another scan, the area will not be displayed.
Two areas of potential motion artifacts are marked in the topogram. They show the estimated position in the scan, when the heart motion is most likely to occur.
The recon job, which is displayed with the heart icon next to it, defines the heart region of the scan.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
7 Enhanced examination
Blue box: Spiral scan range
Magenta box: Selected range
White boxes: Non-selected ranges of the selected scan
You cannot delete the cardiac/standard dose recon job. A copy of this recon job will only inherit the normal parameters but not the property for defining the cardiac/ standard dose range.
If you resize the range of the cardiac/standard dose recon job or move it, the values will be adapted.
You can adapt the scan range in the usual way. ( Page 310 Planning an Examination)

section.title: Achieving a maximum temporal resolution
section.hierarchy_path: /Enhanced examination/Cardiac CT/Reconstructing/Achieving a maximum temporal resolution

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Achieving a maximum temporal resolution
To reduce motion artifacts, you can use a special parameter setting for cardiac Dual Energy spiral scans.
To set the recon parameters of cardiac Dual Energy sequence scans, see ( Page 228 Defining the recon range).
A Dual Energy spiral was scanned.
◆ Select mono plus in the Recon selection list on the Trigger parameter card. In comparison to the regular Dual Energy reconstruction, only one image series is reconstructed.
The number behind the entries in the Recon selection list shows the temporal resolution of the reconstructed images.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Selecting phases for Multiphase reconstruction
For Multiphase reconstruction, select the desired phases first.
◆ Select phases in the range 0% to 100% or -2000 ms to 2000 ms in the list on the Trigger parameter card.
– or –
Select a range of phases by clicking and dragging the mouse in the blue bar.
If all phases cannot be displayed at once, you can scroll the multiphase list to the left and to the right.
If you have not selected a phase, it changes to yellow.
